Application Data.NAME: Smith & Co. Printing Solutions
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith & Co. Printing Solutions specializes in high-quality printing and copying services, offering a range of products including business cards, brochures, and promotional materials. We pride ourselves on our attention to detail and customer service, ensuring timely delivery and satisfaction. Our operations include both in-store services and a small online component for easier access to our offerings. We maintain appropriate Errors & Omissions (E&O) coverage to protect against potential claims related to our services.

Underwriting Guidelines:
– Businesses offering limited ancillary services like basic printing or notary services, pro-
vided they carry appropriate Errors & Omissions (E&O) coverage.
• Not Acceptable:
– BPP exceeding $1,000,000 due to increased exposure to theft, fraud, and property dam-
age.
– Engagement in ineligible or high-risk service operations such as hazardous materials
handling, freight forwarding, or large-scale warehousing.
– Businesses deriving 75% or more of their revenue from online sales without robust fraud
controls or with inadequate cyber security measures.
– Operations involving drone delivery services, due to regulatory complexities and elevated
liability risks (see Industry-Specific Restrictions).
